claims.text: Cole was selected for the chairmanship by the House Republican Steering Committee before the full Conference ratified him.

edges.label: Representative, Oklahoma 4th district; Chairman of Appropriations from April 2024
edges.note: The House Appropriations chairmanship is one of only two House seats in the section 119 group that sit on the money side; the other is the Defense Subcommittee chair held by Ken Calvert.
